The Xobin Platform
Everything it takes,
in one platform.
From first screening to final offer, and everything after - Xobin runs on a single connected system.
Skill Assessments
3,400+ prebuilt tests for skills, coding and psychometrics, with detailed reports that let you shortlist on demonstrated ability instead of resumes.
Learn more
Role Based Assessments
2,500+ prebuilt job-role tests mapped to the exact position you need to fill, so every candidate is evaluated on what the role actually demands.
Agentic AI Interviews
Structured, role-specific AI interviews with evidence-linked scores, available on the candidate's schedule and ready for your review the moment they end.
Advanced AI Proctoring
Identity checks, browser controls and AI monitoring keep remote assessments honest, so scores from anywhere stay trustworthy enough to act on.
Applicant Tracking
Requisitions, assessments and interviews live in one connected hiring pipeline, giving every stakeholder a clear view of where each candidate stands.
Coding Assessments
Live coding across 50+ programming languages with automated test cases and code-level reports that show how candidates think, not just whether code runs.
360° Performance Review & Upskilling
360° feedback surfaces each person's strengths and gaps, and targeted learning paths turn those insights into measurable growth over time.
Psychometric Testing
Measure cognitive ability, personality and behaviour with job-relevant assessments, so you understand how candidates will perform before day one.
White Labeling
Deliver assessments under your own brand, domain and emails, so candidates experience a hiring journey that feels entirely yours.
